title: Split component CSS wrapper
summary: Splits the backend-served WebView component stylesheet into import-ordered component child CSS files while keeping styles.components.css as the parent wrapper.
reason: Execute the first parent file in the CSS split implementation pack without changing visual declarations or top-level asset import order.
